{{Quote|We happened across pirates attacking a refugee ship from the Mid Rim. Shameful.''"<br />"''Fortunately, we intervened in time. Tau and Arn are still chasing down the pirates, but the refugees are in dire need of medical supplies and other essentials.|Ardinondu Dipolus Daeruun and Gnost-Dural speak about their encounter with the pirates|<ref name="Echoes" />}}
The '''pirate attack in the Mid Rim''' was an attack that the [[Dire Skulls]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] led against a [[Refugee/Legends|refugee]] ship in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. The forces of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] were able to intervene and succeeded in ensuring that the refugees were saved from the pirates. Following the fight, the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Tau Idair]] and her [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Arn Peralun]] were dispatched to pursue the remaining pirates. It was hoped that Idair and Peralun would be able to recover additional intelligence about the attack when the remaining pirates were captured.<ref name="Onslaught" />
